snippet.title: Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day: Activity Center (2000, PC) - Videogame Longplay
snippet.description:
Entertain your child on a rainy day; with six different activities at three different difficulty levels, kids of all ages can enjoy time spent inside. A friendly narrator greets you on "a blustery day." He presents activities such as Eeyore's house hunt - help Owl to find a new home; Heffalumps and Woozles - match the characters in Pooh's dreams; and Fly a Piglet - prevent Pooh and Piglet from running into trees and stumps. Follow the story and play with Roo, Tigger, and other favorite characters.

-- Activities --

Fly a Piglet:
Pooh and Piglet need your help to get to Owl's house through obstacles on the ground and in the air. For all levels: avoid bumping into the obstacles by moving your cursor up or down while it is over Piglet. 

Level 1: The screen will scroll slowly and has the least number of obstacles. 

Level 2: The screen will scroll by at a moderate speed and the number of obstacles will increase. 

Level 3: The screen will scroll quickly and you will have to help Pooh and Piglet avoid even more obstacles. 

Clicking on the Start Again icon begins the game again. You may change levels at any time during game play.

Heffalumps and Woozles:

In this activity, Pooh is sleeping and dreaming of mysterious creatures called Heffalumps & Woozles. There are two ways to enjoy this creative activity. You can build the creature that appears in Pooh's dream or you can build your own Heffalumps & Woozles by choosing from the pieces floating around the screen. In create your own mode, you can mix and match different legs, faces, heads and bodies.

Hillside Party Hop: 

Move around the game board to collect as many prizes as you can in the time allotted. When you land on a prize square, the prize will appear on your side of the hill. To keep track of the number of prizes you've collected just look at the number in the balloon on your side of the hill. 

Level 1: Prizes appear and move around the game board, you also have the longest amount of time to play. 

Level 2: Prizes appear and then move around more often during gameplay; there are sticky spots to slow you down; and you have less time to play. 

Level 3: Prizes appear and move around frequently.  In addition to sticky spots of spilled honey, you have the least amount of time to collect prizes. 

Gopher has also left a hole or two for you to use, jump in one end and pop out the other. 

Clicking on the Start Again icon begins the game again. You may change levels or the number of players at any time during game play. 

Eeyore's House Hunt: 

Help Eeyore build a bridge across the flooded 100 Acre Wood to find Owl a new home. Use the planks in the lower stream to help Eeyore build a bridge. Roll your cursor over each plank to see what it will look like when it is placed on the water. If a red X appears on the image of the plank you will know it won't fit in that spot. If you don't see a plank you'd like to use just click on the turtle and a new set of planks will appear. Once you have determined which plank has the best fit, click on it and it will appear on screen for Eeyore to walk across. Be careful not to let Eeyore scroll off too far to the left or you will have to start again. 

Level 1: The screen will scroll slowly, has the shortest distance to the other side of the woods and has the least number of obstacles. 

Level 2: The screen will scroll by at a moderate speed, has a longer distance to cross than level 1 and the number of obstacles will increase. 

Level 3: The screen will scroll quickly, has the longest distance to cross and you will have to avoid even more obstacles. 

Clicking on the Start Again icon begins the game again. You may change levels at any time during gameplay. 

Decorate Owl's House: 

Owl needs help decorating his new house with items he has stored in boxes. You can choose which type of items you would like to decorate with by clicking on the little boxes, on the interface bar at the bottom of the screen. Once you have selected the type of items you would like to decorate with a large box containing the items will slide into the room. Click once on an object to pick it up from the box then click again somewhere in Owl's house to place the object. You can also change the color of certain items in Owl's new house. To change the color of something other then an object from a box, simply click on it. 

Read the Story and Find the Bees 

Come read about a very Blustery Day in the Hundred-Acre Wood. Find out how Pooh and his friends are affected by the storm. While reading the story, keep a look out for buzzing bees! They need to make a beeline to the hive or Pooh will have a honey shortage. Click a bee when you see one and it will fly off the screen and back to the hive. Upon finishing the story Pooh will tell you if you've found all the missing bees.

#Animation #Funny #Educational   

Website: https://www.nostalgiarealm.com
